content:
Apple TV today released a trailer for "Last Seen," a brand-new thriller that will kick off the streaming platform's fall lineup next month.

"Last Seen" premieres September 9 as Apple's latest thriller series

Apple TV has a busy few months ahead. The critically acclaimed "Ted Lasso" has already returned, sci-fi series "Dark Matter" is also incoming, and there are more compelling shows and films to follow.

One of these, a new series titled "Last Seen," has just made its debut alongside an official trailer.

"Last Seen" will premiere its first two episodes on September 9 (Wednesday), then drop new episodes weekly on Wednesdays through October 7.

This Australian thriller stars Patrick Brammall as a police dispatcher who receives a distress call from his daughter, who disappeared 11 years ago.

Here's the official synopsis from Apple, followed by the trailer:

"Last Seen" is adapted from award-winning author Ryan David Jahn's novel of the same name, "The Dispatcher" (Amazon affiliate link here).

Are you planning to watch "Last Seen" when it premieres? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month (about HK$100), and is also available at a discount as part of an Apple One bundle.
